overall.one_line_summary: PR CI showed that generated P0 and literature projections embedded Windows-only raw source hashes even after output bytes were stabilized.
strengths: The repository-local byte regression exposed the contradiction before merge.
The read-model revision, proposal status, and zero measured P2 counters remained correct in the clean Linux checkout.
weaknesses: Two P0 contract files and 153 literature digests lacked explicit byte-preservation attributes while their raw SHA-256 values were projected.
The prior repair governed generated output bytes but not every raw-hashed source byte.

strengths: GitHub Actions run 30744974241 and a standalone LF checkout reproduced the same 164-file drift set.
weaknesses: The earlier evidence stopped at generated-output roots.
suggestions: Extend byte-stability checks to every source whose raw digest is emitted into a projection.

strengths: The failing test identified exact files and byte differences.
weaknesses: Local Windows validation could not falsify source-hash portability while CRLF working bytes remained present.
suggestions: Require both current-worktree and standalone-LF-checkout validation.

strengths: The failure was isolated to repository-safe report provenance.
weaknesses: The affected chain included all P0 reports, 153 literature proxies, the generated manifest, MLflow archive index, and P0 report records.
suggestions: Change only the three source roots that feed the mismatched hashes.

weaknesses: The prior cross-platform completion claim was contradicted by the PR contract job.
suggestions: Keep the PR unmerged until the full contract job and clean-clone regression pass.

strengths: The failed CI result was retained and diagnosed rather than bypassed.
weaknesses: Source digest portability had not been included in the initial failure model.
suggestions: Preserve this finding as a second failure/recovery chain.

strengths: The renderer and read model remained deterministic.
weaknesses: Raw digest inputs were allowed to vary by checkout line-ending policy.
suggestions: Preserve committed LF bytes, regenerate once from the validated read model, and rerun the full check twice.

findings.observation: The P0 read-model schema and reporting-policy hashes plus U001-U153 digest hashes differed between Windows CRLF working bytes and committed LF bytes.
findings.reasoning: Generated files that expose raw source digests are not checkout-stable unless the source bytes are governed as strictly as the outputs.
findings.suggestion: Add no-normalization attributes for schemas/read-model.v2.json, docs/observatory/REPORTING_POLICY.md, and evidence/literature/digests, normalize them to LF, and regenerate the projection graph.

questions_for_owner: No new Owner scientific or gate decision is required for this reporting-source byte repair.
